author: phase23-agent
scope: Matched shadow-fold confirmation of the native raw8 member, activated ONLY if the primary protocol (configs/phase23/raw8_kaggle_prereg.json) nominates at least one candidate. Frozen before any shadow data exists. No submission is authorized by this protocol.
activation: primary numerical_gate_pass == true for at least one candidate; otherwise this protocol is void and recorded as NOT_ACTIVATED.
question: Is the primary marginal of replacing the certified route member with our native raw8 member inside the certified 50/50 logit composition (with the auxiliary10 arm) reproducible on an independent fold geometry (seed 777001), with all arms retrained on the shadow FIT rows?
why_not_a_standalone_ab: The member-level A/B (raw8 vs route2 standalone) is NOT the right endpoint: the certified route2 standalone OOF (0.9615159787) is ~3.7e-4 ABOVE the external raw8 standalone (0.9611450968 on our labels), while raw8 still adds +2.99e-5 pooled at w=0.10 inside the composition (external diagnostic). The claimed mechanism is complementarity inside the composition, so the confirmatory endpoint is the portfolio comparison with a common auxiliary arm.

folds.note: Two predeclared folds only (phase-17 precedent); folds fixed here, before any shadow result exists.

arm_W.member: native raw8 (our folds/protocol): raw 21-column geometry, n_estimators=8, full context, official aggregation

arm_R.member: certified route2 control: route geometry (21 raw + Flight Distance coarse10; categorical [13,14,15,16,18,21]), n_estimators=2, full context, official aggregation, same seeds

arm_A.member: auxiliary10 member-mean, refit on the shadow FIT rows of each fold with the ten certified member definitions read from artifacts/predictions/index.json (entries sol_clean_aux10_primary_*): 3 x xgb (hist), 6 x lgbm extra_trees, 1 x catboost
arm_A.execution: Kaggle CPU script kernel (free tier) or local CPU; the primary aux10 used device='cuda' for the three xgb members, the shadow refits use tree_method='hist' on CPU (documented deviation; the auxiliary arm is COMMON to both portfolios so its device quirks cancel in the W-vs-R contrast)
arm_A.gate: each shadow aux10 member must be fitted on shadow FIT rows only; no primary prediction may enter the shadow evaluation

port_validity_gate.run: raw8 route repro kernel (route geometry, n_estimators=2, PRIMARY fold 0 only)
port_validity_gate.on_failure: OUTCOME_INVALID: the portability of the certified route arm is not established; no shadow statistic is computed. Only the raw8 arm results are archived as diagnostics.

statistics.endpoint_E1_member_ab: pooled paired AUC delta of arm_W vs arm_R over the two shadow folds (diagnostic, recorded, not gating)
statistics.endpoint_E2_portfolio: pooled paired AUC delta of expit((logit(W)+logit(A))/2) vs expit((logit(R)+logit(A))/2) over the two shadow folds, where A is the shadow aux10 member-mean (official logit aggregation identical to the certified composition)
statistics.confirmatory_rule: E2 mean-over-rows paired delta >= +1.0e-5 AND >= 2.5 x paired row-level SE AND both per-fold deltas > 0
statistics.secondary_report: the same contrast with the primary-passing fixed blend weight w* applied as expit((1-w*)*logit(R)+w*)*logit(W)) is NOT used here; the composition analogue replaces R by W at the certified 50/50 weight, matching the certified composition formula

decision.confirmed: record SHADOW_CONFIRMED in the ledger; the member becomes eligible for a submission decision under PATH A/B (separate committed decision)
decision.not_confirmed: record SHADOW_NOT_CONFIRMED; the primary marginal is classified as fold-specific and no submission may rest on it

cost.cpu_refit_hours_estimate: 2-4 h wall on a free Kaggle CPU kernel (parallel with the GPU arms) or local CPU

known_deviations: Two shadow folds (2 and 4) rather than five; SE is over folds plus a pooled row-level paired SE, mirroring the phase-17 shadow confirmation scope.
The shadow aux10 refits run on CPU (device deviation for the three xgb members); the arm is common to both portfolios.

The shadow arms run on Kaggle T4 (fp16 autocast) while the certified primary route/raw members ran locally on the RTX 5070 Ti (bf16 where native); the port validity gate bounds this risk for the route arm.

The generator script scripts/phase23/make_shadow_kernel.py (sha256 f8a2e2005c08bc926abea807dcd5e5e6f9bd4c6bb9d0aed874a97a08202cf422) produced the three kernel variants; each variant's gen manifest records its hashes.
stop_rules: Never run without the activation condition being met.
Never use the shadow folds for tuning or selection of any kind.
Never bypass the local GPU hardware stop; Kaggle free quota only.
Any submission requires a separate committed SUBMISSION_DECISION under PATH A/B and an OOF gain threshold the primary evidence alone may not meet.
